response.overview: Go Hungary is a personal film diary showing life in Hungary under Viktor Orbán’s rule, from the perspective of teenage twins Nati and Dorka. Anger, frustration, and the fatigue caused by the country’s political situation become the starting point for a story about the girls’ everyday lives. Together with the girls, we travel through places marked by omnipresent propaganda and look for safe spaces where freedom can be felt.
response.title: Go Hungary
